title: Question 14
passage:
Could you hold my place in line while I move my bike off the path?
A. Sure. I'll tell the next person you were here. B. The bike rack is made of steel. C. I moved mine before the line formed.
passageZh:
我先把自行車移離步道，你能幫我保留排隊的位置嗎？
A. 可以。我會跟下一位說你原本在這裡。 B. 自行車架是鋼製的。 C. 隊伍排起來之前，我就把自己的車移開了。
